season.evidence: Stored Jul-Sep. Web search found the ridge was first completed in mid-September and is a long rock ridge reached from the Cedar Creek side, so it wants dry rock; no route-specific month guidance exists (summitpost Silver Star Mountain Okanogan page, openbeta listing). Peak-wide logged ascents peak in May-June but those are snow/glacier trips on the other side.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Burgundy Col then glacier to the saddle then scramble, from the Highway 20 side; not the Cedar Creek east ridge. Belongs to the Silver Star Glacier route.
Logged as the South Route (south gully to the main saddle); a different line from the east ridge, and it matches no route we hold on this peak.
Bench camp, glacier traverse and the col below the summit scramble: glacier route.

season.evidence: Stored Jul-Sep; the rock line is reached via the glacier, so it needs the snow to have receded. Web search (summitpost, Mountaineers Silver Star Creek page) gave only general late-spring-through-fall peak guidance, nothing specific to this ridge.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Glacier-to-saddle standard route; none of the harvested tracks name or describe the northeast ridge rock line.

notes: No harvested track climbs either of these two routes. All summit tracks follow Burgundy Col or Silver Star Creek to the glacier (the route that already holds a track), or the south gully (aid 3292837, a South Route we do not hold). The South Route might be worth a catalog entry if the owner wants it; its Aug 2 2026 report approaches via the Big Snagtooth trail into the Willow Creek basin. Other routes on the peak (Northwest Face, West Face Couloir) were not in this packet.
